This section examines Iteration 22 — rho_1
ablation from first

principles. Keep two questions separate:
does changing the order change

the measured outcome, and does the
proposed search method beat

a matched alternative at the same
distinct-evaluation budget? Compare

independent move-pair rho_1, random-walk
rho_1, and negative mean absolute

fitness difference. Budgets 50, 100, and
500 samples; 200 resamples;

typed landscapes plus the six-module LLM
cache. Independent pair accuracy:

0.827, 0.915, 0.991. Independent pairs
were strongest at the low

budget used by the protocol. The
distinction is part of

the result. A large ordering effect does
not automatically imply
